messages.content: Refund policy: refund 100% only if provider_error=true. Refund 50% if latency exceeds 120s and output_tokens < 200. Important exception: do not refund if user_cancelled=true after model_started_at, even if latency later exceeds 120s. If refund_count >= 3 in 24h, require support_review.
Do not refund after user cancellation once model started; abuse threshold 3 refunds per 24h.
